# APA & MLA citation formatter

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/citation-formatter/

Build a basic webpage, book or journal citation from entered source details. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Choose a study tool and review its input labels.
2. Enter your scores, course details, passage or available study time.
3. Run the tool and review the result and its assumptions.

## Example

Enter an author, title, publication date and URL to create a webpage citation in APA 7 or MLA 9 format.

## Limits and checks

This handles common citation patterns, not every style exception. Review capitalization, multiple authors and institution-specific requirements.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
